scheme_name: Chief Minister Higher Education Encouragement Scholarship Scheme
other_conditions: The student must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
The student must be enrolled in a Graduation or Post‑Graduation course at a government college or university.

For the first year of graduation, the student must have scored at least 80% marks in the 12th examination; for subsequent years and for postgraduate courses, at least 60% marks in the previous examination are required.
The student must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in the course or subject.
The student must not have faced any disciplinary or legal action from the college or any legal authority.
The student cannot receive more than one scholarship from the state government in the same year.
Marks obtained from a marks improvement examination will not be considered for this scholarship.
benefits_summary: Provides monthly scholarships of ₹1,500‑₹3,000 for top‑ranked students in each year of graduation and ₹2,000‑₹5,000 for postgraduate years, plus lump‑sum awards up to ₹60,000 for top performers.
